name: NeMoBench
description: Recent advances in video large language models (VideoLLMs) call for new evaluation protocols and benchmarks for video-language understanding. Inspired by the needle in a haystack test widely used by LLMs, we introduce a novel task of Needle in a Montage (NeMo), which is designed to assess the temporal understanding capabilities of advanced VideoLLMs. Specifically, the proposed task focuses on two fundamental abilities critical for temporal understanding, i.e., retrieval-style long-context recall and temporal grounding.
